mapper.insert: INSERT INTO role (id, tenant_id, code, name, builtin, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{code}, #{name}, true, now(), now(), NULL, NULL) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, code) WHERE NOT deleted DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO membership_role (membership_id, role_id, owner) SELECT #{membershipId}, id, owner FROM role WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND code = 'owner' AND NOT deleted ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT i.email, i.phone FROM role r JOIN membership_role mr ON mr.role_id = r.id JOIN membership m ON m.id = mr.membership_id JOIN identity i ON i.id = m.identity_id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.code = 'owner' AND NOT r.deleted AND NOT m.deleted AND NOT i.deleted AND m.status IN ('active', 'invited')
SELECT r.code FROM membership_role mr JOIN role r ON r.id = mr.role_id WHERE mr.membership_id = #{membershipId} AND NOT r.deleted ORDER BY r.code
